content.executive_summary:
- **Identity verified**: Nicolas André is a CNRS senior researcher (Directeur de recherche) at IRAP (Institut de Recherche en Astrophysique et Planétologie), Toulouse, and since March 2024 also affiliated with the DEOS department of ISAE-SUPAERO as a seconded professor. Email `nicolas.andre@irap.omp.eu` confirmed on CNRS and ORCID. ORCID 0000-0001-8017-5676 → https://orcid.org/0000-0001-8017-5676
- **Research scope**: Comparative magnetospheric physics, planetary space plasmas, thermal plasma specification models for space missions; PI/Co-I on multiple in-flight and in-development instruments (BepiColombo/Mio MEA, JUICE/PEP, Comet Interceptor/LEES, Tianwen-4/ENI, M-MATISSE Deputy PI).
- **Active competitive grants (post-2024)**: ANR FACOM (PI, 2022–2026; running through 2024–2026 window) and ANR CANTALOUPE (Co-I, funded). European SPEARHEAD-HE (IRAP partner, Horizon Europe grant 101135044, 2023–2026). ERC CALYPSO was not selected in Phase 2 (2024) and resubmitted (2025).
- **PI/co-PI status**: Clearly PI on instrument hardware, deputy PI on M-MATISSE, and PI on submitted/funded French ANR projects. ERC CALYPSO remains the largest open grant attempt to track.
- **Hiring evidence**: No verified public posting of an open PhD/postdoc position currently attributed to Nicolas André or his team; the IRAP/OMP thesis-proposals page points to the ADUM doctoral-school portal (no Nicolas-André-attributed 2026 thesis ad was retrieved in public sources).
- **LinkedIn**: A different "Nicolas ANDRÉ" (Business Development Director) dominates French LinkedIn results; the researcher's own LinkedIn profile is sparse (8 connections per extract). Public LinkedIn evidence of recruitment posts is therefore not established.

content.2_recent_and_active_funding:
### 2.1 ANR FACOM — "Le destin des composés volatils dans les lunes galiléennes" (PI)

- Funder: Agence Nationale de la Recherche (ANR), call CE49 "Système solaire et conditions d'apparition de la vie."
- Project code: ANR-22-CE49-0005.
- Scientific leader at IRAP: Nicolas André (PEPS team).
- Period: 01/10/2022 → 31/03/2026 (so still active in 2025 and into 2026).
- Description: studies volatile compounds (e.g., water, CO₂, salts) on the Galilean moons of Jupiter, with implications for JUICE mission data analysis.
- Source (IRAP funded-projects list): https://www.irap.omp.eu/en/funded-projects-at-irap
- Source (ANR project page): https://anr.fr/Projet-ANR-22-CE49-0005

### 2.2 ANR CANTALOUPE — "CentrifugAl iNstabilities and Turbulence in plAsmas" (Co-I, funded)

- Funder: ANR.
- Co-investigator at IRAP: Nicolas André (PEPS team).
- Status: listed as a funded ANR project on the IRAP funded-projects table.
- Source (IRAP funded-projects list): https://www.irap.omp.eu/en/funded-projects-at-irap

### 2.3 SPEARHEAD-HE (Horizon Europe, Horizon Europe grant 101135044; IRAP partner)

- Funder: European Union, Horizon Europe (HE).
- IRAP partner; lead coordinator: National Observatory of Athens.
- Period: 2023–2026 (active during the required window).
- Coordinator-of-record: Athanasios Papaioannou (NOA); the IRAP team is led by Alexis Rouillard (per the SPEARHEAD-HE partners page); Nicolas André is the IRAP institutional contact per partner-list materials.
- Source (SPEARHEAD-HE about): https://spearhead-he.eu/about/
- Source (IRAP as partner): https://spearhead-he.eu/irap/

### 2.4 ERC CALYPSO — "History of the Galilean Moons' Hydrospheres" (PI; not yet funded)

- Funder: European Research Council (consolidator-type).
- PI: Nicolas André.
- Status: not selected in Phase 2 (2024 round); resubmitted in 2025; outcome pending. Not currently an active grant.
- Source: https://pagespro.isae-supaero.fr/nicolas-andre/projects-and-responsibilities.html

### 2.5 Mission hardware / consortia (instrument leadership, not grants)

These are mission-instrument roles, not funding awards, but they are how his team supports postdoctoral and engineering positions:

- BepiColombo/Mio (JAXA, in flight): Lead Co-I on the Mercury Electron Analyzer (MEA) — PI: André (per ISAE profile).
- JUICE (ESA, in flight, 2023 launch): Co-I on the Particle Environment Package (PEP).
- Comet Interceptor (ESA, Phase B/C/D): PI of the Low Energy Electron Spectrometer (LEES); flight model delivered May 2026 per ISAE profile.
- Tianwen-4 (CNSA): PI of the Electron and Negative-Ion spectrometer (ENI).
- M-MATISSE (ESA, Phase A): Deputy PI.
- CNES R&D on silicon detectors for charged-particle instruments: Co-I.

### 2.6 Other notes

- Nicolas André was also listed as PI of the European-project Europlanet Research Infrastructure (until mid-2020s); this falls outside the 2024-onward funding window so is mentioned only for completeness.
- SPEARHEAD-HE is the most recent major European grant for which the IRAP PI is not Nicolas André but IRAP is a partner; Nicolas André is the IRAP institutional representative.

content.5_confidence_and_caveats:
- **High confidence**: identity, current dual affiliation (IRAP/CNRS + ISAE-SUPAERO since March 2024), PEPS membership, ANR FACOM and ANR CANTALOUPE attribution, instrument roles, SPEARHEAD-HE participation.
- **Medium confidence**: exact funding amounts in EUR are not posted on the public IRAP table; the figures would need to come from the ANR project pages or CORDIS, neither of which we extracted.
- **Low / null confidence**: any claim of an open PhD or postdoc position personally tied to Nicolas André for 2025–2026 — not found in public sources checked. Also, ERC CALYPSO resubmission outcome is unknown (decision typically returns within ~6 months of submission).
- The IRAP funded-projects table is the authoritative single source for ANR projects; the SPEARHEAD-HE consortium page is authoritative for EU-level role.
content.6_what_was_checked_and_yielded_no_public:
- IRAP "Offres de thèse" / news pages — no 2026 thesis topic attached to Nicolas André was returned in this search.
- EURAXESS — no live offer from IRAP/ISAE-SUPAERO naming Nicolas André as supervisor at the time of search.
- ADUM SDU2E — only the doctoral school landing page was returned; thesis-topic listings were not exposed in the snippet.
- LinkedIn (researcher's profile) — no public job-post content surfaced.
content.7_recommendations_next_steps:
- Track the ERC CALYPSO resubmission outcome (consolidator call 2025, expected reply spring 2026) on the ERC portal: https://erc.europa.eu/.
- Monitor ANR CANTALOUPE deliverables (kick-off typically 6–12 months after funding decision).
- For any future PhD/postdoc tied to André, the first authoritative check is the ADUM SDU2E theses portal and the IRAP "Offres" RSS.
- For instrument-engineering postings tied to LEES, M-MATISSE, or CNES R&D, monitor CNES "Offres d'emploi" and ESA's STEM recruitment portal.
